questions.question: What does saving money mean?
options: Setting aside part of your income for future use
questions.explanation: Saving means keeping part of your available money for future needs or goals.

questions.question: What is an emergency fund mainly used for?
questions.explanation: An emergency fund provides money for unexpected necessary expenses.

questions.question: Which habit can help someone save consistently?
options: Saving only when money is left over by chance
Setting aside a planned amount regularly
questions.explanation: Regularly setting aside a planned amount makes saving more consistent.

questions.question: If you save ₹2,000 every month for 6 months, how much will you save?
What is a financial savings goal?
options: A specific amount of money you plan to save for a purpose
A requirement to spend all your money
A way to avoid tracking money
questions.explanation: A savings goal defines what you want to save for and how much you need.
